title: Logosbook
summary: Logosbook is a spell that allows the caster to communicate with another Seeker using a book. One Seeker writes in the book, and the message appears in the other book.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Logosbook was used by Zhalia Moon to enchant journals owned by herself and Dante Vale when she went undercover as a Silent Soldier initiate so she could inform him of the activities of the Blood Spiral. [Zhalia's Mission]

After Den Fears and Lok Lambert were attacked by Tantras' students in the Streets of Venice, Zhalia used Logosbook to inform Dante that the Spirals were looking for Den. Later, Dante gets a hunch and decides to check his book, reading Zhalia's message and deciding to face Tantras head-on. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

With the Blood Spiral army approaching the Fortress of Iron Will, Zhalia used the spell to inform Dante. He shortly used Logosbook himself to receive her message. [Sophie on Trial]

On the longest night of the year, Zhalia used the spell to inform Dante of the location of the Spiral Mark on the Siberian Plateau. [Words from Eathon]

With Dante seemingly sacrificing himself to stop the impact of the Red Comet, he had written a message to Zhalia using Logosbook, saying "You can't get rid of me that easily". As all hope seemed lost in the fight against the Betrayer, Zhalia remembered Dante decided to check her book, reading the message. This prompted Umbra to teleport to her location, bringing back Dante's ashes. This allowed him to revive after using Copykind to mimic Phoenix's ability to rise from the ashes. [Dante's Return]

full_text:
Logosbook is a spell that allows the caster to communicate with another Seeker using a book. One Seeker writes in the book, and the message appears in the other book.

== History ==
Logosbook was used by Zhalia Moon to enchant journals owned by herself and Dante Vale when she went undercover as a Silent Soldier initiate so she could inform him of the activities of the Blood Spiral. [Zhalia's Mission]

After Den Fears and Lok Lambert were attacked by Tantras' students in the Streets of Venice, Zhalia used Logosbook to inform Dante that the Spirals were looking for Den. Later, Dante gets a hunch and decides to check his book, reading Zhalia's message and deciding to face Tantras head-on. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

With the Blood Spiral army approaching the Fortress of Iron Will, Zhalia used the spell to inform Dante. He shortly used Logosbook himself to receive her message. [Sophie on Trial]

On the longest night of the year, Zhalia used the spell to inform Dante of the location of the Spiral Mark on the Siberian Plateau. [Words from Eathon]

With Dante seemingly sacrificing himself to stop the impact of the Red Comet, he had written a message to Zhalia using Logosbook, saying "You can't get rid of me that easily". As all hope seemed lost in the fight against the Betrayer, Zhalia remembered Dante decided to check her book, reading the message. This prompted Umbra to teleport to her location, bringing back Dante's ashes. This allowed him to revive after using Copykind to mimic Phoenix's ability to rise from the ashes. [Dante's Return]

* Zhalia has been using the same journal since Season 1, where she often took notes while still an agent of the Organization. However, it seems that it was not yet enchanted with Logosbook, as Zhalia sent information to Klaus using her phone instead.
